Top News
 
 
 
 
narvikk/E+ via Getty Images
 
 
 Wall Street closed the week mixed as a sharp spike in volatility reflected fresh tech struggles, while investors continued to digest hotter-than-expected CPI data and the latest bank earnings.

CPI inflation heated up in September. On a year-over-year basis, the Consumer Price Index rose 3.7%, matching the consensus forecast and accelerating from a 3.4% gain in August.

The Cboe Volatility Index ( VIX ) surged roughly 30% on Friday afternoon to trade above 21, reaching a more than four-month high as tech stocks continued to struggle.

Big banks kicked off Q3 earnings season as traders digested results from Goldman Sachs ( GS ), JPMorgan ( JPM ), Citigroup ( C ), Wells Fargo ( WFC ), and other major lenders.

For the week, the blue-chip Dow ( DJI ) added +0.67% , the benchmark S&P ( SP500 ) lost -1.95% , and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( C OMP:IND) plunged -4.48% . Read a preview of next week's major events in Seeking Alpha's Catalyst Watch. 


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Economy
 
 
 
 Behind on the bills 
 
 
 
The U.S. government isn't the only one with a debt problem. 1 in 5 Americans fell behind on a loan or mortgage payment in 2025, according to new data from the Federal Reserve. That figure is up from 1 in 8 Americans in 2022 and marks the highest level since 2007. Why is it happening, and what will it mean for the economy?   Read more.

Weekly Movement
 
 
 
 U.S. Indices 
Dow +0.7% to 52,002. S&P 500 -2% to 7,659. Nasdaq -4.5% to 26,140. Russell 2000 -3.1% to 2,721. CBOE Volatility Index +34.7% to 19.99. 

 S&P 500 Sectors 
Consumer Staples +5% . Utilities +2% . Financials +1.4% . Telecom -1.6% . Healthcare +3.4% . Industrials -0.9% . Information Technology -6.4% . Materials +2.5% . Energy +5% . Consumer Discretionary -1.9% . Real Estate +1.1% . 

 World Indices 
London +3.1% to 10,882. France +2% to 7,957. Germany +2.1% to 25,623. Japan -5.4% to 65,324. China -2.6% to 3,716. Hong Kong -0.1% to 24,187. India +3.1% to 74,729. 

 Commodities and Bonds 
Crude Oil WTI +10.9% to $101.84/bbl. Gold -0.7% to $4,186.7/oz. Natural Gas -3.1%  to 3.12. Ten-Year Bond Yield -0.2 bps to 5.098. 

 Forex and Cryptos 
EUR/USD +0.33% . USD/JPY -0.21% . GBP/USD +0.71% . Bitcoin -1.7% . Litecoin -6.8% . Ethereum -3.1% . XRP -6.5% . 

 Top S&P 500 Gainers 
Fair Isaac ( FICO ) +16% . Cognizant Technology Solutions ( CTSH ) +12% . Equifax ( EFX ) +11% . Brown & Brown ( BRO ) +10% . Accenture plc ( ACN ) +10% . 

 Top S&P 500 Losers 
Ciena ( CIEN ) -26% . Coherent ( COHR ) -26% . Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ) -25% . Hewlett Packard Enterprise ( HPE ) -25% . Skydance ( SKYD ) -25% .
